empty: No fresh events above the importance threshold
empty_channel: No ready or published posts yet
empty_hint: Events from the last 3 days above the importance threshold appear here once they have a post in the channel language. A post in another language waits until the AI rewrites it. Check the filters and the active sources.
changed: The event changed. Refresh and try again.
preparing: Writing the post… up to a minute
schedule_note: The post becomes “Ready” and goes into the channel calendar on the Autopost tab. You can cancel it there.
channel_off: Autoposting for this channel is off: the post goes out only once it is turned on.
wrong_lang: The post is in “{lang}”, but channels publish in another language: {channels}. Rewrite the post — the AI writes it in the channel language.
approved: Post approved: it goes to the channel on schedule
